content_of_post_to_comment: This reminds me that I’ve met multiple foreigners who believe that the French Revolution inspired the American Revolution, and will actually laugh when you inform them that the American Revolution came first and inspired (at least to a significant extent) the French Revolution. The American Revolution is incredibly underrated from a historical standpoint.
comment: The irony is that the two revolutions exported different things: America offered a constitutional model, while France pushed universal rights and popular sovereignty toward more radical conclusions. Influence isn't the same as imitation.
